adadive/types/DealDatum.title: DealDatum
adadive/types/DealDatum.description: The datum attached to an escrowed deal UTxO.

fields.title: client
fields.description: Client who funded the deal and may reclaim on expiry/cancellation.

fields.title: provider
fields.description: Provider who receives payment on successful settlement.

fields.title: oracle
fields.description: Trusted arbiter that attests proof-of-storage in the v1 oracle model.

fields.title: data_hash
fields.description: Hash / IPFS CID of the stored data this deal covers.

fields.title: payment
fields.description:
Amount escrowed for the provider (lovelace, or THT quantity), informational
 for indexers; spend authorization is enforced via signatures + timing.

fields.title: storage_gb
fields.description: Storage size in gigabytes the provider committed to.

fields.title: start_time
fields.description: POSIX time (ms) when the deal became active.

fields.title: deadline
fields.description:
POSIX time (ms) by which the provider must settle; afterwards the client
 may unilaterally refund.

fields.title: model
fields.description: Settlement model in force. v1 requires `OracleAttested`.

fields.title: challenge_window
fields.description: v2 challenge window length (ms). Ignored by v1; set to 0 for v1 deals.

adadive/types/DealPhase.title: DealPhase
adadive/types/DealPhase.description:
Lifecycle phase of the escrowed deal. v1 only ever sees `Locked`; the other
 phases exist so v2's claim/challenge flow slots in without a datum change.

anyOf.title: Locked
anyOf.description: Funds are escrowed; awaiting settlement, refund, or cancellation.

anyOf.title: Claimed
anyOf.description:
v2 (reserved): provider has posted a completion claim; challenge window
 is open until `challenge_deadline`.

adadive/types/DealRedeemer.title: DealRedeemer
adadive/types/DealRedeemer.description:
Actions that can be taken against an escrowed deal UTxO.

 Constructors are append-only: v2 will add `ProviderClaim`, `Challenge`, and
 `Finalize` without removing or reordering these, so existing off-chain
 encoders remain valid.

anyOf.title: Settle
anyOf.description: v1: oracle + provider co-sign to release payment to the provider.

anyOf.title: Refund
anyOf.description: Client reclaims the escrow after `deadline` has passed with no settlement.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Client and provider mutually agree to unwind the deal at any time.

adadive/types/SettlementModel.title: SettlementModel
adadive/types/SettlementModel.description:
Which settlement rules govern a deal. v1 deals are always `OracleAttested`.
 `OptimisticChallenge` is reserved for v2 and is rejected by the v1
 validator, so a v1 script can never be tricked into running v2 semantics.

anyOf.title: OracleAttested
anyOf.description:
v1: a trusted arbiter (`oracle`) co-signs settlement to attest that the
 provider has demonstrated valid proof-of-storage off-chain.

anyOf.title: OptimisticChallenge
anyOf.description:
v2 (reserved): provider claims optimistically; anyone may submit a fraud
 proof during `challenge_window` before funds finalize.
